stage: market specification after frozen synthetic resource gate, before any new market fit or new Shenzhen workbook acquisition
purpose: Evaluate a restricted conditional persistence model and learning objective. Established Markov/reset models and proper scoring rules are not claimed as new.

data.development_panels: EUA_LONG/GUANGZHOU/HUBEI/SHANGHAI x 2021/2022/2023, excluding SHANGHAI2021 by the pre-existing whole-year rule:11 panels
data.new_source_missing_rule: Use source rows with valid dates and finite numeric close. Do not fill, round, interpolate, reorder or insert zeros. Preserve source order and reject duplicate/nonincreasing retained dates.
data.new_source_price_domain: For the included <=2021 sequence, any finite price<=0 rejects the entire Shenzhen source for this round. Do not silently delete nonpositive prices or shift the log domain.
data.new_source_exposure: The old project already mechanically parsed the source and some historical Shenzhen data. 2020/21 are first model-training/scoring use in this project, not a claim that the market or workbook has never been seen.
data.workbook_decoding_boundary: Use the established xlrd decoder. Its internal decoding may include2022 source cells. Only dates<=2021 may enter experiment arrays, and the incomplete2022 year is wholly excluded. This clarification replaces the earlier conversational suggestion of never decoding2022, before acquisition; the enduring reserved2024+ restriction is unchanged.
data.reserved: No2024+ prices; no opening other future confirmation files
data.split: Identical maxh20 common-origin train/126validation/annual test rules in PROTOCOL.json and prepare_data.py
data.primary_stratum: 11 previously explored development panels,22 h5/20 cells
data.additional_stratum: 2 first-model-use Shenzhen panels,4 h5/20 cells; report separately
data.no_adaptive_market_selection: Prepare and train all valid prespecified panels before inspecting their aggregate comparison scores. Shenzhen does not depend on development market wins.

model.initial_state: pi, the stationary law of the origin-frozen reset kernel
model.pi_and_scale: Fit pi and f0 using only training one-step CRPS; pi softmax of two free logits plus reference zero, bounds[-6,6]; f0 in[.25,2.5]; L-BFGS-B maxiter300; start pi(.45,.4,.15), f0=1. Fixed thereafter for every matched arm.
model.emission: zero-mean Gaussian state variance f(X)^2*q_k/E_pi[q] in origin daily-EWMA units
model.transition: P(X)=rho(X)I+(1-rho(X))1pi^T, same kernel at every future step within this forecast origin
model.propagation: Exact variance-lattice DP over current state and m=n_middle+5*n_high; at step h, sigma_m=f(X)*sqrt((h/4+3m/4)/(h E_pi[q])); at most5h+1 grid slots, including zero-mass slots
model.consistency_scope: A common within-origin future increment law. No claim of tower consistency across separately reconditioned forecast origins. No drift, leverage or arbitrary variance-term-structure prediction.
model.persistence_head: rho(X)=sigmoid(logit(rho_base)+b(X)); no artificial rho clipping during training
model.rho_base: For each panel, separately fit a constant rho for endpoint-only and joint005 loss on the training sample. Bounds[.001,.999],21 equally spaced grid points with local bounded refinement around the lowest grid point; retain endpoint candidates. pi/f0 fixed.
model.initialization: Zero output-head weights/biases. Each neural arm exactly begins at its corresponding frozen constant-rho distribution and f0.
model.GRU_backbone: GRU input3 hidden16 single layer; last hidden state
model.features: Same train-standardized20x3 window of r_t/causalEWMA_sigma_t, log sigma_t, log1p calendar-day gap for all candidate arms
model.scale_capacity_control: Same two-output head capacity as conditional model; f=f0*(.5+sigmoid(a+.5*tanh(b))), rho=rho_base fixed. Extra output changes the scale rather than persistence.
model.independent_horizon_control: Common scale but independent neural rho heads for h5 and h20; h1 has no unused rho head. Endpoint-only loss. These separate marginals are explicitly not asserted to arise from one common future transition kernel.
model.training_objective: Per-origin equal mean CRPS over h1,5,20 in common normalized-return units, plus .05*mean path NLL per future step for joint005 arms. NLL uses the same20 future increments and exact log-domain HMM likelihood.

training.validation: Choose minimum equal-horizon normalized CRPS among all40epochs and epoch0; retain earliest strict improvement. Training does not stop early. No test-based selection.
training.refit_schedule: One fixed trained model per market-year/backbone/arm/seed; no parameter updates in test. Causal inputs use observations available at each test origin.
training.if_shenzhen_rejected: Run264 neural fits and33 static fits on the11 development panels; record excluded source and reason; do not substitute a market.

evaluation.primary_statistic: Within each market-year-h5/20 cell, average seed mean scores first, compute method/matched-1, then equal-weight cells. GRU16 is main; MLP16 is a separately reported backbone replication.
secondary: mean price squared error vs random walk
evaluation.prices: Use full lognormal-mixture price moments and CRPS. Zero log-return mean does not imply price mean equals current price.
evaluation.uncertainty: 1999 paired circular block bootstrap resamples within each fixed annual cell, common origin indices across methods, block40, nominal95%. Preserve paired seeds by averaging predictions' scores within origin. This is approximate dependent-data uncertainty, not evidence about a population of independent markets.
evaluation.internal_continuation_checks: GRU development primary mean<0, at least60% cells strictly better, bootstrap95% upper<0; main also lower than scale-capacity control on average; MLP primary mean<0; Shenzhen additional stratum mean<=0 if available. These are an internal research decision, not a journal's acceptance standard.
evaluation.if_checks_fail: Stop this fixed candidate; do not tune q, losses, horizon set, seeds, market years or open2024+ to rescue it. Finish all already specified baselines and report the failure faithfully.
evaluation.paper_claim_boundary: Even passing these checks is not enough to claim SOTA or paper readiness without further directly comparable published-model reproduction and independent validation.

artifact_policy: All source, protocols, aggregate results, methods, literature, execution summaries and audits enter the new public Git branch. Raw prices, per-origin derived prices/features, forecasts and model checkpoints remain in the private run archive. Existing research files stay byte-identical.
